name: Forward Fashion (International) Holdings Company Limited
summary: Forward Fashion (International) Holdings Company Limited, established in 2005 and headquartered in Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong, is a fashion apparel retailer with operations in Macau, mainland China, Hong Kong, Taiwan and other markets. It sells its own brands such as UM, UM Junior, IXOX and WF Fashion through dedicated stores, and has expanded into footwear, cosmetics, skincare, home accessories and lifestyle goods, sold in stores and online.
